scope: Current G-AnnStudio documentation and the G-Overlay Lab feature slice

architecture_recommendation.rationale: Moderate Tauri + React desktop codebase, a mature feature slice, privacy/security boundaries, and no evidence that AI/ML lifecycle documentation is the primary product concern.

not_recommended_yet.reason: AI-assisted media tooling is present, but no owned model lifecycle, dataset, or training pipeline was found in this package.

findings.title: Content taxonomy lacks document control metadata
findings.details: docs/content-taxonomy.md has a proposal status in prose but lacks version, author, created/updated timestamps, and a version-history table.
findings.action: Add the standard YAML metadata and changelog when the proposal is next revised.

findings.title: One intentional planned graph gap remains
findings.details: GOE-005 points to a planned cloud-sync component with no implementation. This is an approved C-3/HIGH boundary, not a contradictory stale document claim.
findings.action: Retain the gap until a separate cloud threat model and contract are approved.

findings.title: No model-card appendix is present
findings.details: The selected 3-Layer + Appendix structure does not include Appendix C because no owned model lifecycle, dataset, or training pipeline was found in this package.
findings.action: Add Appendix C only if G-AnnStudio begins to ship or operate a model lifecycle.

findings.title: Cross-repo graph nodes record unresolvable paths
findings.details: Five nodes point at G-Maiden files using paths written as 'G-Maiden/...', which cannot resolve from the G-Suite root. Any checker walking defined_in reads them as dangling. The files exist — the reference form is what is wrong.
findings.action: Give cross-repo targets an explicit repo prefix (e.g. 'gmaiden:src-tauri/src/gsi.rs') or record the sibling checkout root, so a resolver can tell 'other repo' from 'missing'.

findings.title: Two new Overlay Lab modules carry no @req annotations
findings.details: lib/labView.ts and components/OverlayModulePreview.tsx entered the graph this session via the import graph, not via annotations. Both are inside the GOE scope; neighbouring files (OverlayLab, overlayLayout) do carry @req/@spec headers.
findings.action: Add @req/@spec headers so the edges come from declared intent rather than inference.

passes.details: The approved 3-Layer + Appendix core now has a docs index, PRD-SDD, architecture, contribution guide, frontend design system, API index, and appendices A, B, D, E, and F.
Appendix F defines the shared G-AnnStudio and G-Maiden terminology used by the scoped documents.

Sprint 3 refresh confirms the Figma editor specification, verification records, traceability matrix, and scanned implementation agree on optional startMs/endMs timing, future keyframes, SVG rasterization before runtime handoff, preflight wired into the local BannerProject composition adapter, and the distinction between the 0.5-3.5 second authored-animation ceiling, local 3.5-second previews, and G-Maiden's 4.0-second show plus 0.8-second exit lifecycle. The BannerEditor test provides local-preview evidence only; GOE-004 remains partial and full runtime HUD acceptance remains open.
21 scanned documents: zero broken file://, relative or wiki links. (Cross-repo node paths are tracked separately as WARN-003.)

Sprint 3 refresh: docs/.doc-graph.json parses; its declared counts match contents (52 nodes / 97 edges), all file-backed SHA-256 prefixes match the current scoped documents and code when G-Maiden paths resolve from the sibling checkout, and its annotation metadata traces BannerProject timing, bannerComposer frame planning, the existing WebP adapter, Ann Pack priority, and pure preflight. GOE-003 remains partial pending byte-budget and target-renderer smoke; GOE-005 remains proposed.
Vitest passes 22 tests across BannerProject, store history, BannerEditor jsdom behavior, motion preflight/frame planning, and authored Ann Pack priority.
TypeScript noEmit and the Vite production build pass; the bundle-size notice remains non-blocking.
The RWANG Mellum alignment gate found no conflicts between BannerEditor component-test behavior and the Figma editor specification.

refresh_note: Sprint 3 candidate frame-composition refresh after the authored-animation, local-preview, and G-Maiden runtime-lifecycle distinction was documented. Recomputed file-backed graph hashes and rechecked current annotation metadata at 52 nodes / 97 edges; retained the two existing warnings plus GOE-003 partial / GOE-005 proposed evidence boundaries and no target renderer handoff claim.
